title: Speaking — Keeping things organised
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on keeping things organised.

questions: What is a typical breakfast for you?
When do you usually eat your main meal?
Which meal of the day do you most look forward to?
Do you enjoy eating with several other people?
Do you prefer a tidy desk or a busy one?
What system do you use to find things at home?

part2.topic: Describe a time when getting organised made an important task easier.
part2.closing: and explain how the method affected the task.

questions: Why do people disagree about what an organised workspace looks like?
What can designers do to make small living spaces easier to organise?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to keeping things organised?
